resumeText:
Sai Teja Reddy | Hyderabad | saiteja.reddy@example.com | github.com/saiteja-de

EDUCATION
B.Tech Computer Science (Data Science), CVR College of Engineering, Hyderabad, 2026 | CGPA 8.3/10

INTERNSHIPS
Data Engineering Intern, Charminar Analytics Pvt Ltd, Hyderabad | Jan 2026 - Apr 2026 (12 weeks)
- Wrote Python scripts to pull daily sales CSVs from an SFTP folder and load them into PostgreSQL.
- Wrote SQL with joins and window functions to build daily and weekly sales summary tables.
- Moved raw files to an AWS S3 bucket and read them with a Glue job set up by the team.
- Kept all pipeline code in Git and raised pull requests for review.

Data Analyst Intern, Deccan Retail Mart, Remote | June 2025 - July 2025 (8 weeks)
- Cleaned store-level sales data in pandas and shared weekly reports with the category team.

PROJECTS
- NYC Taxi Pipeline: Built an ETL pipeline that cleans 10 million taxi trip rows with PySpark and writes Parquet files partitioned by date.
- Cricket Stats Warehouse: Designed a star schema with match, player and venue dimensions for IPL ball-by-ball data in PostgreSQL.
- Stock Price Tracker: Python script that fetches daily prices from a public API into SQLite.

COURSEWORK AND CERTIFICATIONS
- Coursework: DBMS, Big Data Analytics, Distributed Systems, Data Warehousing and Mining
- AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner, 2025

SKILLS
Python, SQL, PostgreSQL, PySpark, pandas, AWS (S3, Glue), Apache Airflow, Git, Linux, Excel

ACTIVITIES
- Volunteer, Data Science Club workshops on SQL for juniors.
- College cricket team.
